column1: # OLMoE-1B-7B: joint free-set comparison at R=8 of 64, gate_mass=preserve (after the artifact fix). Residency imposed on every layer EXCEPT the named set; all sets free exactly 4 of 16 layers, so the comparison is matched on resident-memory budget. Damage is BPB above a residency-off baseline scored on the same block. 3 disjoint blocks of 32 sequences give the spread. Producer: analysis/ple/olmoe_freeset_joint.py
